title: Bumper: Correction
mood: sober: a rewind, then the motif backwards, resolving calmly
description: Segment bumper for Correction, built from Zoo's motif (3.4 s).
usage: Cut on the downbeat at the segment change; the music is finished before the file ends. -16 LUFS-I.
selfReview: Sober: a reversed piano swell (the rewind) runs straight into the motif played backwards, calm, resolving to D minor. It is the darkest bumper (harshness -8.6). Its piano voicings were thinned and 700 Hz cut after the first render read boxy. It is normalised to the same -16 LUFS-I as the others, so check that it does not feel louder than its mood.
